title: Imaging Review Visits from Recent Lab and X-Ray Work-Up — Primary Care Provider Assignment
content:
**Claims schedule — imaging review visits on a second-opinion referral, Primary Care Provider Assignment.**

Imaging review visits are added to a second-opinion referral's visits, before the single-referral visit ceiling is applied. They are counted as the member's paid lab and x-ray claims — claims in the lab and x-ray category booked on the member's **Medicaid Managed Care Membership** — with a service date in the work-up window of **3 months**: two or more claims add the two-visit imaging allowance, exactly one adds the one-visit imaging allowance, and none adds nothing.

| Paid lab and x-ray claims in the last 3 months | Imaging review visits added |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 |
| Exactly 1 | 1 |
| None | 0 |

**Window.** The work-up window is a trailing period counted back from the handling date in whole months: a claim is inside it when fewer than 3 whole months separate its service date from the handling date, so a claim dated exactly 3 months back is outside it.

**Hypothetical members, handling date 15 September 2026**

- Paid lab and x-ray claims on 16 June and 9 September 2026: both inside, 2 visits.
- Paid lab and x-ray claims on 15 June and 9 September 2026: 15 June is exactly 3 months back and outside; 1 visit.
- A denied lab claim on 9 September 2026 and nothing else: no paid claim, no visit.
